svg.title: Terminal session: a database connection that times out, tunnels-manager opening a Google Cloud IAP tunnel, and Luciano Bosco's profile read back out of a MySQL result set.
svg.text: luciano - software engineer, 14 years. Malaga, ES.
databases | data pipelines | the platforms behind video and stock content
ERROR 2003 (HY000): Can't connect to MySQL server on '10.24.6.11' (110 timed out)
# nothing is listening. nothing at work is reachable from a laptop, ever.
| databases | MySQL, BigQuery, query plans at 03:00 | 14 |
| services | Python, PHP/Laravel, Go, some Vue | 12 |
| platform | Google Cloud, Kubernetes, a little AWS | 8 |
| pipelines | Temporal, batch that has to survive a retry | 6 |
ERROR 1142 (42000): SELECT command denied to user 'visitor'@'github'
-- 4 public repos. the other 14 years ship under NDA. this is the tell.
# the whole job is making that line boring. it has been boring for years.
